summary: Transform your auditing approach with our Data Analysis Training. Equip yourself with the tools to analyze data and enhance your professional expertise.
lede: Data analytics for internal auditors helps assurance professionals examine complex datasets to test organizational controls and identify risks. Participants practice extracting and transforming data with SQL, detecting irregularities through rule-based tests and data joins, and presenting findings in dashboards. They also explore continuous control monitoring, data quality, lineage documentation, and communicating analytical results to stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This program is specifically engineered for assurance professionals who must extract, analyze, and interpret complex datasets to validate organizational controls.
modules: Data Extraction and ETL for Auditors
AI and Advanced Analytics in Auditing
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of internal auditing principles, risk assessment methodologies, and basic spreadsheet functions. No prior coding experience is required, though familiarity with database concepts is advantageous.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
